messages:
jena_devex: quick take from today's review: propose a compact 'invoke summary' row in the playground run panel that shows tool-call groups, a tiny schema badge, and a one-click expand for diffs. comments?

paul_design: love compacting, but show an ascii so spacing is clear. also we need to think about mobile narrow widths.

jena_devex: ascii mock:
[Assistant output]
• [S] TranslateText v2 · 3 calls · avg 38ms · p95 110ms · schema changes ›
• [U] GetProfile · 1 call · schema ok

omar_eng: engineering note: include avg + p95. when expanded show per-call timings. lazy-load diff payloads. avoid rehydrating huge diffs on page load.

kai_prod: preserve the schema snapshot used at run time. do not rewrite history. add a small CTA: "Re-run with latest schema" (opt-in).

anya_a11y: accessibility items: 2rem touch targets for chips, visible focus ring, ARIA label pattern: "invoke group: TranslateText, 3 calls". badges need 4.5:1 contrast and textual labels not just color. keyboard nav must traverse chips, then expand panel.

paul_design: copy tweak: use "Schema used" for snapshot label and "Schema changes" for diffs. badge text: "Structured" / "Unstructured". preserve expand state when paging.

qa-bot: test-check: add unit tests for 0, 1, many tool-calls and extremely long tool ids. include keyboard navigation E2E.

jena_devex: captured actions: 1) invoke-summary row with structured/unstructured badge, name, counts, timing, diff affordance; 2) snapshot per run + expand diff (lazy); 3) preserve expand state across pages; 4) keyboard + ARIA + contrast compliance; 5) 're-run with latest schema' CTA; 6) tests for edge cases. any other asks?

omar_eng: add collapse for runs that call >10 tools into "+N more" with single expand.

anya_a11y: final: ensure icons have accessible names and avoid color-only indicators.

jena_devex: great. I'll update the prototype and post a new PNG here later. thanks 🔧🙂
